::: {.callout-note title="Tip!"}
- Submit your abstract early well before the deadline to have something in.
- Set a virtual deadline at least 2 days before where you do a test submission.
- When collaborating with others, set a deadline well before to get their comments and discussion, after which you move forward with the submission
:::
